approved8.electric_ring: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production Bullets of Fury HD arcade sprite effects. Generate a premium hand-pixeled NEO-GEO electrical reactor shock-ring animation on REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA. ONE sprite sheet, EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS BY TWO ROWS, EIGHT equal square cells read left to right. Fixed center within every cell, generous transparent gutters. Each cell a successive moment of ONE explosion, never eight different designs. Frame 1 compact cobalt/violet electrical star ignites; 2 small jagged hollow blue-white corona; 3 expanding circular electrical ring with thin branching lightning; 4 larger bright chrome-white ring with blue/violet stepped highlight ramps; 5 maximum diameter ring breaks into angular ion arcs; 6 fragmented ring disperses radially; 7 scattered energized sparks; 8 final few crisp blue/violet sparks. All frames viewed face-on in the SAME plane, no rotation, no tilted discs, no rings crossing through each other. Detailed SNK-era arcade pixel clusters with rich chunky shading and high-resolution authored detail, bright readable white core contours and saturated blue/violet ions. Cooled black gaps in the hollow center. Clean dramatic silhouette on a dark starfield at 150px game size. Animation carries its own expansion in the artwork, NOT identical ring copies or a smooth vector glow. NO background, NO robot, NO text, NO labels, NO checkerboard pixels, NO blurry haze, NO glossy 3D torus, NO grey smoke discs, NO other objects. Preserve transparent alpha. Canvas 4:2 grid, each frame entirely contained in its own square cell.

Generate a spectacular NEO-GEO hand-pixeled plasma-fire explosion animation with rich detailed stepped orange, scarlet, white-hot cream, purple and cobalt shading. Real transparent alpha. EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS BY TWO ROWS, EIGHT equal square cells, fixed center per cell, empty generous gutters, no labels. One continuous expanding explosion read left to right: 1 small hard white ignition cross and violet sparks; 2 compact molten orange fireball; 3 broad lumpy billowing flame lobes around a white core; 4 large dense fiery eruption with blue-violet ion arcs at its edges; 5 widest flowering fireball with dramatic yellow/orange curled flame tongues and a few chrome casing fragments; 6 burst collapses into charcoal smoke lobes with incandescent red cracks and glowing fragments moving outward; 7 separated ember-filled smoke puffs and flying small shards; 8 last cool charcoal puffs and sparse red embers. True authored in-betweens, no repeated frames. Main fireball is round and volumetric as classic Metal Slug-style arcade explosions, no dull 3D rendered dust, no vector spokes as the main shape, no transparent fading orange blobs. Crisp high-quality pixel clusters, dark sharp shadow bands, energetic layered silhouette, clear at 140px in-game yet detailed at 256px. No scenery, no starfield, no character or ship, no text, no ground shadow. DO NOT add any flat grey elliptical smoke ring. Do not clip any flame, spark, smoke or fragment at cell borders. Entire source sprite cells share the exact SAME camera, center and cell size; preserve real transparent alpha.

No blurry airbrush, no realistic 3D torus, no flat grey ellipse, no spinning rings, no rings crossing each other, no solid spherical fireball in the center, no scenery or characters, no text, no labels, no checkerboard. All sparks and smoke fully contained inside their frame, never touch source cell edges. Substantial crafted arcade detail suitable for 220px in-game blast.
